capabilities: Generate a day-by-day study plan from the headings of notes in a course folder
Write daily quiz questions from those notes with a local Ollama model
Mark weak topics from quiz results and rebuild the remaining review days
Export quiz questions as Question::Answer flashcards tagged for the Spaced Repetition plugin
extras: The manifest carries Obsidian's standard 'not manually reviewed' notice. README warns that a small model can still invent content, so answers deserve a check. Free, MIT-licensed, no accounts, API keys or telemetry; quizzes need a local Ollama server but plans work without it. Part of the author's Companion suite of local-first plugins.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to turn a course folder and an exam date into a scheduled study plan, self-testing questions, or flashcards from your own notes.

relations.evidence: a daily quiz generated by a local model (via Ollama) from those notes
Pairs with Lecture Companion: its lecture notes (## Summary, ## Transcript, ## My notes) are one topic each
Question::Answer lines in the format the Spaced Repetition plugin reads

summary: Exam study planner that builds a day-by-day plan from course notes, generates daily quizzes with a local Ollama model, and exports flashcards.
